name: Why Not Both?
description: While you field 2 of the same Form Swapper in different forms, both gain @BonusStats@ Ability Power, Armor, and Magic Resist, and @BonusStats@% Attack Damage. When you 3-star a Form Swapper, gain a 2-star copy. Gain a Swain and Gangplank.
